{{Quote|Go and meet Dray Ithicus, one of our other couriers, and be careful. Black Sun has been pestering our couriers recently. Be assured that won't last much longer.|Karena Keer to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Dray Ithicus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Dray Ithicus]]
Dray Ithicus was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].

He was identified as a male in the quest dialogue, but his appearance was randomized. Some species he could appear as included [[Human/Legends|Human]], [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]].
